title: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.17 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in…
description: rConfig Core versions before 8.2.17 and rConfig Pro versions before 8.4.0 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Config Search View Matches dialog. This dialog renders configuration context using v-html without proper escaping, allowing attackers to inject malicious markup into device banners, interface descriptions, ACL remarks, or SNMP locations. Successful exploitation can lead to script execution in a user's session and unauthorized access to stored configurations containing sensitive secrets.
